canonical_project: Volgograd Region Center for Information Technologies prefab modular data center
owner: GreenMDC / Sunline Engineering for GKU VO TsIT VO
notes: Prefab modular data center for Volgograd regional executive authorities, delivered and commissioned in early 2018. Sources describe 26 600-mm server cabinets plus four 800-mm cabinets and useful load of 160 kW.
